column1: # content: the internal steps of the nine integrations of the file t2_steps_runs.csv (checks GS-17 to GS-20): the number of the step
column2: the time at its end as the integrator reports it
column6: the value of the local error test of the integrator (the weighted root-mean-square norm of its estimate of the local error)
column7: the same norm of the exact local error
column8: the norm of the exact local error
column9: the cosine of the angle between the exact local error of the step and that of the step before (both carried to the same time by the exact evolution; 0 for the first step)
column10: the norm of the deviation from the exact solution at the end of the step
column11: and the rounding of the time variable up to the end of the step (the exact sum of the step sizes so far minus the reported time); all steps of an integration with at most 3000 steps
